sources: Blender 5.2 UV and Cycles baking manuals
retained_decisions: Treat a connected compound form as a cut graph: identify periodic tube regions and open each with a hidden longitudinal seam.
A UV layer is not evidence of a usable unwrap; measure degeneracy, bounds, positive-area overlap, angle error, and area-ratio variation, then inspect a checker on the actual material.
Use Average Island Scale and Pack Islands with positive margin after seam correction.
For tangent-normal baking, require a UV-ready low cage, active target Image Texture node, Cycles selected-to-active, positive margin, Non-Color data, a saved image, and a connected Normal Map node.
Reject visual defects independently of green numeric checks; the first clasp passed metrics but was discarded for self-intersection.
transfer: The weird-cube seam strategy was transferred to a different C-shaped clasp cage with independent high/low topology.
counterevidence: Purposeful seams reduced mean angular error from 14.90 to 3.97 degrees and 36.02 to 5.09 degrees, but checker deformation remains visible on high-curvature transitions; seam placement alone does not guarantee distortion-free UVs.
